python3 - <<'PY'
import json, time, urllib.parse, urllib.request
BASE='http://192.168.0.16/rpc/'
NAME='Local Climate Link Thermostat'
def rpc(method, **params):
    cooked={k: ('true' if v is True else 'false' if v is False else v) for k,v in params.items()}
    url=BASE+method
    if cooked:
        url += '?' + urllib.parse.urlencode(cooked)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=5) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read().decode())
def output():
    return bool(rpc('Switch.GetStatus', id=0).get('output'))
scripts=rpc('Script.List').get('scripts', [])
managed=[s for s in scripts if s.get('name') == NAME]
assert len(managed)==1, managed
sid=int(managed[0]['id'])
print('MANAGED_SCRIPT_ID='+str(sid), 'INITIAL_RUNNING='+str(bool(managed[0].get('running'))))
def finish_safe():
    rpc('Script.Stop', id=sid)
    rpc('Switch.Set', id=0, on=False)
    time.sleep(0.2)
    final_off=not output()
    final_running=bool(rpc('Script.GetStatus', id=sid).get('running'))
    print('FINAL_RELAY_OFF='+str(final_off))
    print('FINAL_SCRIPT_RUNNING='+str(final_running))
    assert final_off and not final_running
def pulse(label, script_running):
    if script_running:
        rpc('Script.Start', id=sid)
        time.sleep(0.5)
    else:
        rpc('Script.Stop', id=sid)
        time.sleep(0.2)
    rpc('Switch.Set', id=0, on=False)
    time.sleep(0.15)
    assert output() is False
    t0=time.monotonic()
    rpc('Switch.Set', id=0, on=True)
    samples=[]
    for target in (0.0,0.05,0.10,0.25,0.50,1.00):
        while time.monotonic()-t0 < target:
            time.sleep(0.005)
        samples.append((round(time.monotonic()-t0,3), output()))
    rpc('Switch.Set', id=0, on=False)
    time.sleep(0.2)
    final=output()
    print(label, 'SAMPLES='+json.dumps(samples), 'FINAL_OFF='+str(not final))
    assert final is False
try:
    rpc('Switch.Set', id=0, on=False)
    time.sleep(0.2)
    print('BASELINE_RELAY_OFF='+str(not output()))
    pulse('SCRIPT_STOPPED', False)
    pulse('SCRIPT_RUNNING', True)
finally:
    finish_safe()
